blind.description: A freestanding or wall-mounted stone fountain featuring a stepped square base plinth, a fluted pedestal stem supporting a scalloped semicircular water basin, and an arched backplate adorned with a shell-like fluted niche, side pilasters, and a protruding central water spout. The back of the structure is flat. The model exhibits weathered light-grey stone textures with realistic green moss growing in crevices and carved details.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a semicircular scalloped basin bowl with a central spout extending outward from a flat, straight back wall flanked by rectangular column caps.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.2 feet tall (roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.8 feet wide.
